items.title: Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4「Argon」前沿模型及机器人版本
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini 4 'Argon' Frontier Model and Robotics Variant
items.summary: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 'Argon' (plus a robotics variant), prompting heavy HN discussion with users praising its writing and reasoning abilities while criticizing the confusing free-trial rollout.

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.title_zh: Anthropic 为高速扩张的 monorepo 重新设计源码控制系统
items.title_en: Anthropic redesigns source control for its fast-growing monorepo
items.summary: Anthropic describes redesigning its source control system around a growing monorepo, including a Git-to-Scion ingestion pipeline partly rewritten by an internal Claude model.

items.title: 11 year old unsoundness bugs found in Rust borrow checker
items.title_zh: Rust 借用检查器被发现潜伏 11 年的健全性缺陷
items.title_en: 11-Year-Old Unsoundness Bug Found in Rust Borrow Checker
items.summary: An 11-year-old unsoundness bug in the Rust borrow checker was discovered and is being fixed by making the compiler reject previously accepted invalid code.

items.title: We turned EmbeddingGemma 2 into a speech-to-text model
items.title_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2 被改造成本地语音转文字模型
items.title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2 Repurposed into a Local Speech-to-Text Model
items.summary: An experiment shows EmbeddingGemma 2 can be hacked into a local speech-to-text model by exploiting its shared text-audio embedding space, yielding decent accuracy and fast performance without cloud models.

items.title: Character.ai has initiated voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy
items.title_zh: Character.ai 申请 Chapter 11 破产，并以 2000 万美元向迪士尼出售部分资产
items.title_en: Character.ai Files for Chapter 11, Sells Assets to Disney for $20M
items.summary: Character.ai has filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy and agreed to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million, following the departure of its founding team to Google in a 'hi-quire' arrangement.

items.title: 🛒 谷歌被令取消第三方应用商店安装障碍，一周内去除多余警告步骤  美国地区法官 James Donato 下令谷歌简化竞品安卓应用商店的安装流程，删除 Play
items.title_zh: 法官下令谷歌取消第三方安卓应用商店安装障碍
items.title_en: Judge Orders Google to Strip Friction From Third-Party Android App Store Installs
items.summary: A US judge ordered Google to strip anti-competitive friction from third-party Android app store installations within one week, following the Epic v. Google antitrust ruling.
